name: Contour Correspondence via Object Set Overlap
definition: A method to determine if a contour $C_k^t$ at time $t$ corresponds to a contour $C_{k'}^{t+1}$ at time $t+1$ by checking for overlap between their associated upper and lower object sets.
summary: Contour Correspondence via Object Set Overlap tracks contour evolution by verifying that bordering upper and lower object sets overlap, avoiding interpolation artifacts.
